scientific_scope: Freeze the next Layer B diagnostic calibration design after completion of the first five-model low-context calibration. This is not a confirmatory campaign and cannot establish universal ECC/AMCE thresholds or a universal model ranking.

rows.replacement_reason: runtime endpoint truth exposed no healthy >=128K Kimi K2.6 route; Kimi K3 preserves the planned Kimi/Chinese slot

low_context_calibration_evidence.unreconciled_policy: UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN; missing billing evidence must never be converted to synthetic zero
low_context_calibration_evidence.frozen_score_policy: Do not retroactively alter these scores. In particular, natural-language resource aliases such as 'existing command router' versus canonical 'command_router' may expose a deterministic scorer normalization issue, but any scorer change requires separately governed methodology and cannot rewrite this frozen calibration evidence.

layer_b_deterministic_evidence.boundary: deterministic benchmark plumbing/discrimination evidence, not LLM performance evidence

context_assembly.assembly_seed_policy: A deterministic internal assembly seed is derived from SHA-256('ACCB-DEV-004|0.1|<anchor_tokens>'); use the first 32 bits as an unsigned integer. This controls benchmark context construction/order only and does not claim deterministic provider generation.
must_record_before_each_call: exact filler/distractor corpus version and order

provider_seed_policy.claim_boundary: Provider seed is a capability-dependent best-effort control, not a universal determinism guarantee.
provider_seed_policy.decision_rule: Send the same anchor assembly seed as provider seed only when the fresh selected endpoint advertises seed AND the transport adapter has a no-paid contract test proving the correct wire key. Otherwise omit provider seed, record null plus the reason, and keep the cell calibration-only.

known_runtime_evidence.z-ai/glm-5.2: seed advertised in retained endpoint census; adapter delivery still requires no-paid contract validation
known_runtime_evidence.qwen/qwen3.7-plus: seed advertised in retained endpoint census; adapter delivery still requires no-paid contract validation
known_runtime_evidence.moonshotai/kimi-k3: seed advertised in retained endpoint census; adapter delivery still requires no-paid contract validation
known_runtime_evidence.deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813: seed NOT advertised by the retained selected DeepSeek endpoint; omit unless fresh runtime truth changes
known_runtime_evidence.openai/gpt-5.6-sol: RouterAI catalog advertised seed, but native Responses wire compatibility is not yet validated; do not assume it

provider_seed_policy.confirmatory_implication: This one-repeat diagnostic tranche does not test H1 reproducibility under seed variation. Confirmatory seed/repeat design remains a separate NOT_FROZEN gate.

generation_policy.reasoning_effort: low when supported by the selected endpoint/transport
generation_policy.temperature: 0.0 when the selected endpoint/transport supports temperature; otherwise omit and record null
generation_policy.structured_output: use the already validated transport-specific JSON-output control where supported

assumptions: input-token billing target equals each anchor token count
each cell conservatively reserves the full 8192-token output cap
DeepSeek uses the highest retained time-of-day prompt/completion rates
Qwen applies its retained >256000 prompt-token tier to the 512K anchor
GPT-5.6 Sol applies its retained >272000 prompt-token tier to the 512K anchor
planning_cost_envelope.admission_rule: Immediately before any paid execution, perform a fresh read-only endpoint census, recompute the whole-tranche conservative estimate from actual selected endpoint pricing/tiers, fail closed on missing/non-positive/unparseable pricing, and require explicit owner approval of a spend ceiling that covers the recomputed tranche.

execution_gates: Implement and test the deterministic Layer B context assembler without paid model calls.
Implement provider-seed capability recording and no-paid transport contract tests; never invent seed support.
Perform a fresh read-only RouterAI endpoint census and recompute the 15-call whole-tranche estimate.
Obtain explicit owner approval for the Layer B spend ceiling after the fresh estimate is visible.
Only then create a separately governed paid execution trigger with exact SHA, provider pins, fallback disabled, accounting and evidence publication.

required_before_freeze: seed/randomization design across supported and unsupported provider surfaces
fresh cost envelope and owner-approved budget

next_safe_action: Implement the no-paid Layer B deterministic context assembler and provider seed-capability manifest against this frozen calibration design; do not execute RouterAI model generations.
